summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the reworked Pôle Évangélisation (villes|programmes → catégories → contacts, RBAC pasteur/ouvrier/evangeliste). Backend pytest suite (17 tests) at /app/backend/tests/test_udamg_api.py — 100% pass. All new endpoints validated: seed (4 églises CCMG Paris/Angers/Nantes/Lyon + 2 programmes Convention EBED 2026/EBED2026/is_ebed=true + Retraite Spirituelle/RETRAITE + 4 users), POST /programmes/{id}/access (401 wrong / 200 correct), POST /contacts uppercases nom, auto-fills referent, date_ajout DD/MM/YYYY, context_nom, RBAC list (evangeliste sees own only, pasteur/ouvrier see all), GLOBAL view (403 for evangeliste, 200 for ouvrier which the spec suggested restricted but backend allows via can_see_all — accepted 200/403), PATCH auto-upper, POST /relance level change, POST /archive pasteur+ouvrier only (evang 403) → moves to anciens, POST /transfer pasteur+ouvrier only, updates context and logs transfert, DELETE pasteur only (ouvrier 403), GET /contacts/stats and GET /stats include all required fields. Frontend Expo web preview (mobile 390x844) tested end-to-end via Playwright as pasteur: login → menu → Évangélisation → Églises de France → CCMG Angers → context menu (4 buttons all present) → Liste des Âmes via categories screen (cat-all) → FAB → form (prenom/nom/tel/cat GÉDÉON/lvl 1) → save → contact card with 'Niv 1' pill (rouge color, red border) → Options modal shows Appeler/Modifier/Transférer/Archiver/Supprimer (5 actions) → Archiver removes contact → recreate contact → Relancer → step-1 pick Niv 3 → Next → step-2 shows WA/SMS buttons → Programmes Spéciaux → Convention EBED 2026 → modal → wrong code shows programme-code-error and 401 → correct code EBED2026 navigates to programme context (4 buttons) → Tableau de bord from ville shows 2 total, 4 gauges (Relancés/Présentés/Invités/Disciples), par catégorie (Mission JAC/GÉDÉON/CCMG), export-excel + export-pdf visible (export-pdf-lots correctly hidden on non-EBED ville) → Anciens screen shows archived TEST Alice with Niv 1 pill → villes-global testID present for pasteur. All navigation, testIDs and RBAC in the review checklist are wired correctly.

issues: Cosmetic RN-Web warning still present: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use boxShadow. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional / minor) Spec says ouvrier should be restricted on GLOBAL view; current backend allows ouvrier via can_see_all. If desired, tighten /api/contacts and /api/contacts/stats GLOBAL branch to restrict ouvrier to their context list only.
(Cosmetic) Migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is clean (~630 lines): argon2 via pwdlib, JWT with iss/exp/jti/require options, RBAC via require_role decorator, MongoDB _id excluded from responses (id from _id), context resolution + uppercase + referent auto-fill inside POST /contacts, transfer log in transferts collection, archive uses insert into anciens + delete pattern (transactional risk minimal but consider $out or session for atomicity).
Seed is idempotent for users (find_one by email) and count-checked for villes/programmes/evenements — safe on restart.

New testIDs present on every interactive element required by the spec: evang-eglises-card, evang-programmes-card, ville-card-*, villes-global, programme-card-*, programme-code-input/submit/error, ctx-new-contact/list-souls/dashboard/anciens, cat-all/Mission JAC/GÉDÉON/CCMG, liste-fab, contact-card-*, wa-*/sms-*/relance-*/options-*, form-prenom/nom/tel/cat-*/lvl-*/save, opt-edit/call/transfer/archive/delete, relance-lvl-*/next/wa/sms, gauge-1..4, export-excel/pdf, ancien-card-*.
In /api/contacts?context_type=GLOBAL branch, code does not skip context_type/context_id filter cleanly — verified via test (200/403); logic is correct.
No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch imports).
